report.incidentSummary: On 2026-10-14 starting around 09:10 IST (03:40 UTC), users reported that their investment portfolio screen displayed mutual fund values and P&L from the previous day, while stock valuations remained up to date. The root cause was a data pipeline failure during the nightly scheduled AMFI NAV import at 18:02:00 UTC on 2026-10-13 (23:32:00 IST): market-data-service encountered an unhandled string value ('N.A.') at line 8982 for scheme 118191 in NAVAll.txt, aborting the ingestion before writing any of the 14,231 NAVs. Consequently, market-data-service served stale NAVs dated 2026-10-12 across all mutual funds.
report.rootCauseStatement: The nightly scheduled AMFI NAV import job in market-data-service failed at 18:02:00 UTC (23:32:00 IST) on 2026-10-13 due to an unhandled parse error ('invalid NAV value 'N.A.' for scheme code 118191' at line 8982 of NAVAll.txt). Because the import executed as an all-or-nothing transaction without resilient per-row error handling or subsequent retry mechanisms, 0 of 14,231 NAVs were written, leaving the 2026-10-12 NAV dataset active and causing mutual fund portfolio valuations to remain stale throughout the morning of 2026-10-14.

hypotheses.cause: The scheduled nightly AMFI NAV import job in market-data-service aborted at 18:02 UTC after encountering an unhandled non-numeric value ('N.A.') for scheme code 118191 at line 8982 of NAVAll.txt, leaving 0 new NAVs written and the 2026-10-12 NAV dataset active.
hypotheses.rationale: Direct log and metric evidence from market-data-service and job-scheduler shows the import job aborted at 18:02:00 UTC with an explicit parse error on line 8982, writing 0 records and exiting with code 1. The nav_age_s metric steadily climbed past 125,000s, and portfolio-service logged warnings about NAVs older than 1 trading day.

hypotheses.cause: Deployment CHG-48221 to portfolio-service at 03:40 UTC introduced a regression in valuation calculation logic causing mutual fund holdings to show yesterday's values.
hypotheses.rationale: While CHG-48221 deployed at 03:40 UTC coincided with the timing of user complaints, portfolio-service was already logging warnings about stale NAVs dated 2026-10-12 at 02:16 UTC, over an hour prior to the deployment. Stock valuations were also completely unaffected.

hypotheses.cause: amfi-nav-feed published malformed or non-standard feed data containing 'N.A.' instead of a valid numeric NAV for scheme 118191, violating feed expectations and triggering downstream parser failure.
hypotheses.rationale: The upstream file NAVAll.txt contained 'N.A.' for scheme 118191. However, third-party feeds frequently represent missing or non-computed NAVs as 'N.A.', making robust parsing the downstream service's responsibility.

facts.statement: job-scheduler triggered nightly job nav-import run_7fadae4b on schedule at 2026-10-13T18:00:00.000Z (23:30:00 IST).
market-data-service downloaded NAVAll.txt (1980 KB) from amfi-nav-feed at 2026-10-13T18:01:00.000Z.

market-data-service encountered a parse error at line 8982 ('invalid NAV value 'N.A.' for scheme code 118191') at 2026-10-13T18:02:00.000Z and aborted the import with 0 of 14,231 NAVs written, leaving the previous NAV set active.
job-scheduler marked run_7fadae4b failed with exit code 1 at 2026-10-13T18:06:00.000Z, with jobs_failed metric spiking to 0.0667 count/min and no automatic retries executed.
The nav_age_s metric in market-data-service climbed monotonically from 82,740 seconds at 2026-10-13T17:00:00.000Z to 125,160 seconds (~34.8 hours) at 2026-10-14T04:45:00.000Z without resetting.
portfolio-service logged warnings starting at 2026-10-14T02:16:24.606Z stating 'fund NAV older than 1 trading day for 3 holdings (nav_date=2026-10-12); showing last available NAV'.
portfolio-service's stock price_age_s metric remained healthy at an average of 2.01 seconds throughout 2026-10-14T02:00:00.000Z to 05:00:00.000Z.
portfolio-service deployment CHG-48221 (version 7.2.0 -> 7.3.0) completed at 2026-10-14T03:40:00.000Z (09:10 IST).

inferences.statement: Deployment CHG-48221 did not cause the stale valuations because stale NAV warnings with nav_date=2026-10-12 were already being logged by portfolio-service starting at 02:16 UTC, more than 80 minutes before CHG-48221 was deployed.
Stock prices were completely unaffected by this incident because stock price feeds are ingested via continuous live broker-api streaming, maintaining price_age_s near ~2s.

The entire mutual fund catalog in market-data-service remained stuck on the 2026-10-12 valuation date due to the all-or-nothing transaction design of nav-import, where one invalid entry aborted the ingestion of all 14,231 schemes.

assumptions.statement: The AMFI feed standard occasionally emits 'N.A.' for newly listed, merged, or unpriced funds where day NAV computation is unavailable.

recommendedActions.rationale: Prevents a single unpriced or unquoted mutual fund scheme from blocking NAV updates for the other ~14,200 valid schemes.
